blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) is investigating another Filipino, identified by the alias “Boyet,” who allegedly arranged a private jet to transport drugs from Laos to the Philippines. PDEA has also identified a Filipino passenger using the alias “Fahad,” who was arrested at an airport in Laos in connection with the alleged smuggling
